challenge_rule: Do not reward agreement; challenge material Stage-A nodes, edges, boundary placements, variants, negatives and temporal claims against the adopted source universe.

objection_ledger.challenge: Did Stage A preserve the distinct goal-relevant response-likelihood path as well as the ex-Gaussian RT path?
objection_ledger.finding: Stage A mentions both output families but under-specifies the distinct goal-relevant one-hot/input-to-response branch.

objection_ledger.challenge: Was learned selection history collapsed into one-trial intertrial priming?
objection_ledger.finding: No. Stage A separates learned history-map content from the previous-trial feature-dimension marker.

objection_ledger.challenge: Was task demand converted into a persistent internal coordinator?
objection_ledger.finding: No. Task/goal information remains an external/interface criterion that weights source-defined maps.

retained_negative_or_boundary_conditions: variant/model evidence does not establish universal cognitive necessity
